name: Sovereign Malachai: Formidable Deity of Beholden Rectangles: Intangible War on Dictionopolis
author: Irotpigs
description: The Malachai series is revived 5 long years after the release of Lord God King Malachai of the Rectangles and the Eternal Battle for Triangle Emancipation 2 2. In this prequel, join Malachai in his ascent to lordhood as he takes on regular polygons of sides upwards of SIX!
